title: Wetaskiwin Art and Craft Centre

services.name: Space Rental
services.desc: Not quite ready to become a member but still eager to build on what you learned in class? Open Studio at the Wetaskiwin Allied Arts & Craft Centre (WAACC) gives you the time, space, and tools to keep creating at your own pace. Whether you're refining a new skill or finishing a project you started in a workshop, Open Studio is your chance to stay inspired and keep your hands moving. Open Studio is a relaxed, drop-in session where you can work independently in our shared studio space. services.name: Beginner Pottery Class
services.desc: This beginner friendly pottery course is perfect for those with little or no experience working with clay. You will learn the fundamentals of handbuilding and wheel throwing pottery techniques in a relaxed and supportive environment. Over the 6 classes, you will learn how to center clay on the wheel and form a basic bowl shape, use handbuilding methods such as coil and slab, refine and decorate your pieces, and be introduced to glazing techniques to finish your pieces.
